import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD2 = 1000000007L;
    static long gg = 0;
    static ArrayList<Long>[] v = new ArrayList[10];
    static long[] sum = new long[10];
    static int ans = 0;
    static long n;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        Arrays.fill(sum, 0);
        ans = 0;

        // dfs1 function
        dfs1(0, 0);

        // sort v[0..6]
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(v[i]);
        }

        gg = 0;

        // dfs2 function
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(i);
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static void dfs1(int u, int x) {
        gg++;
        long val = ((gg - x + 998244353L) % MOD1);
        v[u].add(val);
        sum[u] = (sum[u] + (val % MOD2)) % MOD2;
        if (u == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs1(u + 1, 10 * x + i);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(long x) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if (x * 1000000 + 999999 <= n && x * 10000000 > n) {
            long rk = gg;
            for (int i = 0, bit = 1; i <= 6; i++, bit *= 10) {
                long mae = ((rk - x * bit) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
                int pos = lowerBound(v[i], -mae + MOD1);
                long sizeV = v[i].size();
                long sumV = sum[i];
                long term1 = ((mae * sizeV) % MOD2 + sumV) % MOD2;
                long term2 = ((sizeV - pos) * MOD1) % MOD2;
                long temp = (term1 - term2 + MOD2) % MOD2;
                ans = (int)((ans + temp) % MOD2);
                gg += sizeV;
            }
            return;
        }
        gg++;
        long tempAns = ((gg - x) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
        ans = (ans + (int)tempAns) % (int)MOD2;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }
}
